scene_description: A family is camping in the woods. Four people — two adults and two children — are sitting around a round fire pit with a campfire burning inside it. They are roasting marshmallows on sticks. A green tent is set up behind them, and camping chairs are arranged around the fire. Trees surround the campsite.

questions.question: What is in the middle of the picture, where everyone is sitting around?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round bowl in the middle of the picture with orange flames.

questions.question: What are the people doing with their sticks?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the sticks the people are holding toward the fire.

questions.question: Where are the people sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the trees and ground around the people.

questions.question: What is the tent used for when people go camping?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the green tent behind the people and think about what campers do at night.

questions.question: What might the people eat next, after the marshmallows are done cooking?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the marshmallows on the sticks over the fire and think about what comes after cooking food.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been camping or sat around a fire?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you were outside with your family.
